name: Fundamental Paper Education
source:
A paper school is a place where grades decide everything. If you suddenly give up on this, don’t be surprised when your friends turn away from you and some teachers try to get rid of an idiot like you.

[From [url=https://ill-bunnyy.itch.io/fundamental-paper-education]Itch.io[/url]]
